deliverables: Secondary ticket resale marketplace settling transactions on-chain
Custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
Independent third-party security audit with remediation/reporting
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework, for Anvil Development Agency and Sellout.io project delivery.
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform: secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000.
The withdrawal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, inclusive of a 3% Intersect administration fee over 8 months.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, smart-contract royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and a professional launch campaign.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is contracted as an anchor deployment and is projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until reimbursement, then 5% permanently.

Milestone gating, unused contingency return, undisbursed funds remaining under Treasury control, independent audit, oversight review, and quarterly public reporting are presented as treasury protections.
The proposal claims the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
Anvil claims a record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through its infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
On-chain success metrics and repayment progress are to be independently verifiable through explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public dashboard, and Cardano Forum quarterly reports.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 build of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout and built by Anvil, with Intersect administering milestone-based disbursements through TRSC/PSSC and a proposed treasury repayment mechanism.
